verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party automation feature, such as scheduled rollouts, automatic rollbacks, or background agent tasks, that users can set up to run on their own. The Experiment APIs for CI and scripts are developer building blocks for building automation externally, and the flag kill-switch is a manual control. Bandit tests and flag prerequisites are adjacent experiment features, not user-configured autonomous automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
